The *Hetuduka, Vedanāttika* (Patthana 9.2) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection [Catalog]. It constitutes a section within the combinatory system of the *Paṭṭhāna*, specifically joining the Root Dyad (*hetuduka*) with the Feeling Triad (*vedanāttika*) immediately after the Root Dyad's combination with the Wholesome Triad (*kusalattika*) [Nyanatiloka 1938]. In this analytical framework, the dyads (commencing with root conditions) are systematically cross-tabulated with all twenty-two triads of the Abhidhamma matrix, establishing the permutations of conditional relations across doctrinal categories [Nyanatiloka 1938].

No extant parallels in other languages are recorded for this text.
